title: englerina parviflora
intro: Englerina parviflora, commonly known as the West African Angelica, is a plant species in the family Apiaceae. This plant is used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and various other ailments. The therapeutic actions of Englerina parviflora include analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its use in treating pain and reducing inflammation. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, saponins, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
